name: Killer Brownie®
dsc: Killer Brownie's German Chocolate Brownie is a rich, fudgy brownie topped with a classic coconut-pecan frosting that has been a family favorite for generations. This brownie combines the deep, intense flavor of premium chocolate with the sweet, nutty crunch of toasted pecans and shredded coconut. Each bite offers a perfect balance of textures, from the gooey, dense brownie base to the chewy, caramelized topping. This tin pack is ideal for sharing with loved ones, gifting during the holidays, or simply treating yourself to a decadent dessert. Baked fresh in Dayton, Ohio, these brownies are made with high-quality ingredients and a recipe that has been perfected over decades. Whether enjoyed with a glass of cold milk or a hot cup of coffee, this brownie delivers a truly indulgent experience.

name: Magnolia Bakery
dsc: Magnolia Bakery's World Famous Banana Pudding is a legendary dessert that has captured the hearts of millions. This party-sized 64-ounce bowl features layers of creamy vanilla pudding, fresh sliced bananas, and crunchy vanilla wafers, all topped with a cloud of whipped cream. The pudding is made from scratch using a secret recipe that balances sweetness with the natural flavor of ripe bananas. Each spoonful offers a delightful combination of smooth, creamy, and crunchy textures that make this dessert truly unforgettable. Perfect for large gatherings, family reunions, or any occasion that calls for a crowd-pleasing treat, this banana pudding is a New York City icon. It arrives chilled and ready to serve.

name: Jacques Torres Chocolate
dsc: Jacques Torres' World Famous Chocolate Chip Cookies are a New York City institution. Made with a secret recipe that combines premium chocolate chunks with a buttery, perfectly textured dough, these cookies are baked to golden perfection with a crispy edge and a soft, chewy center. Jacques Torres, known as Mr. Chocolate, uses only the finest ingredients, including Valrhona chocolate and high-quality butter. This 6-pack is perfect for sharing with family and friends, or enjoying with a cold glass of milk. Each cookie is a testament to Jacques' passion for quality and his dedication to creating the perfect chocolate chip cookie.

name: The Cannoli Pie Company
dsc: The Cannoli Pie Company's Original Cannoli Pie is a creative twist on the classic Italian dessert. This pie features a flaky, buttery crust filled with a rich, creamy cannoli filling made from fresh ricotta cheese, sugar, and vanilla. The filling is studded with mini chocolate chips and topped with a dusting of powdered sugar and crushed pistachios. Each slice delivers the authentic taste of a traditional cannoli in a convenient pie format. This dessert is perfect for holidays, family dinners, or any occasion that calls for something special. Made fresh in Bridgeport, Connecticut, this cannoli pie is a must-try for anyone who loves Italian desserts.

name: Cotton Blues Cheesecake Company
dsc: Cotton Blues Cheesecake Company's Sea-Salted Caramel Swirl Cheesecake is a decadent dessert that combines the rich creaminess of classic cheesecake with the sweet and salty goodness of caramel. This cheesecake features a buttery graham cracker crust, a smooth and velvety cheesecake filling, and a generous swirl of homemade caramel sauce. A sprinkle of sea salt on top enhances the flavors and adds a delightful contrast. Each slice is a perfect balance of sweet, salty, and creamy textures. Made with premium ingredients and baked to perfection, this cheesecake is ideal for special occasions, birthdays, or simply treating yourself to something extraordinary.

name: Brooklyn Blackout Company
dsc: Brooklyn Blackout Company's Cookie and Brownie Combo Pack includes two tins filled with their most popular treats. The first tin features rich, fudgy brownies made with premium dark chocolate and a hint of espresso to enhance the flavor. The second tin contains soft, chewy cookies packed with chocolate chunks and a touch of sea salt. This combo pack is perfect for those who want to enjoy the best of both worlds. Each treat is baked fresh in Brooklyn using high-quality ingredients and a commitment to excellence. This pack makes an excellent gift for any dessert lover or a delightful indulgence for yourself.

name: Gotta Have S'more
dsc: Gotta Have S'more's Variety Pack features a delightful assortment of gourmet s'mores in different flavors. Each s'more is made with premium chocolate, marshmallows, and graham crackers, with creative twists like peanut butter, caramel, and sea salt. This pack is perfect for anyone who loves the classic campfire treat. Each bite offers the perfect combination of gooey, crunchy, and sweet. Great for parties, gifts, or enjoying by the fire.

name: Crave Cupcakes
dsc: Crave Cupcakes' Best Seller Dozen features 12 of their most popular cupcake flavors. From classic vanilla and chocolate to unique creations like salted caramel and red velvet, each cupcake is baked fresh and topped with a generous swirl of buttercream frosting. These cupcakes are known for their moist, tender crumb and perfectly balanced sweetness. Ideal for birthdays, office parties, or any celebration, this dozen is sure to impress any crowd.

name: Elegant Desserts
dsc: Elegant Desserts' Choose Your Own Ice Cream Donuts 6-Pack allows you to customize your order with six gourmet donuts filled with premium ice cream. Each donut is freshly baked, then filled with creamy ice cream and topped with a variety of glazes and sprinkles. Choose from flavors like vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, and more. These ice cream donuts are a unique and delicious treat that will delight both kids and adults. Perfect for parties, celebrations, or a special dessert.

name: Ess-a-Bagel
dsc: Ess-a-Bagel's Jewish Classics Dessert Pack features a selection of traditional Jewish desserts that have been enjoyed for generations. This pack includes babka, rugelach, and black and white cookies, all made from authentic recipes. The babka is rich and buttery with layers of chocolate or cinnamon, the rugelach are flaky and filled with fruit preserves or nuts, and the black and white cookies are soft and topped with both vanilla and chocolate icing. A perfect gift or treat for any occasion.

name: Bread and Roses Bakery
dsc: Bread and Roses Bakery's Dessert Bar Care Package includes a curated selection of their most popular dessert bars. From rich chocolate brownies to tangy lemon bars and nutty pecan squares, each treat is baked fresh with high-quality ingredients. This package is perfect for sending to loved ones, sharing at a party, or simply enjoying as a sweet pick-me-up. Each bar is individually wrapped for freshness and convenience.

name: Stan's Donuts
dsc: Stan's Donuts' Donut Cookies are a unique and delicious twist on traditional cookies. These cookies are shaped like mini donuts and baked to a perfect golden brown, then topped with a variety of colorful glazes and sprinkles. Each cookie has a soft, chewy texture and a sweet, buttery flavor that makes them irresistible. This 12-pack is perfect for parties, gatherings, or simply enjoying with a glass of milk. Stan's Donuts has been a Chicago favorite since 1965, and these donut cookies are a testament to their commitment to quality and creativity.

name: Malai Ice Cream
dsc: Malai Ice Cream's Gulab Jamun Ice Cream Cakes are a fusion of Indian flavors and American desserts. These cakes feature a layer of creamy ice cream infused with the sweet, floral flavors of gulab jamun, a traditional Indian dessert. Each cake is topped with a honey-saffron glaze and sprinkled with crushed pistachios. This 2-pack is perfect for those who love unique and adventurous flavor combinations. A truly special treat for any celebration.

name: Jacques Torres Chocolate
dsc: Jacques Torres' World Famous Chocolate Chip Cookies 12-pack is perfect for sharing with family and friends. Each cookie is made with a secret recipe that uses premium chocolate chunks and a buttery dough, baked to a perfect golden brown with a crispy edge and a soft, chewy center. Jacques Torres is a master chocolatier, and these cookies are a reflection of his dedication to quality and flavor. This larger pack is ideal for parties, office gatherings, or stocking up your freezer for when a cookie craving strikes.

name: Treat House
dsc: Treat House's Assorted Rice Krispie Treats 12-pack features a variety of gourmet rice krispie treats in different flavors. From classic original to chocolate chip, sprinkles, and even seasonal specials, each treat is made with premium marshmallows and crispy rice cereal. These treats are soft, chewy, and perfectly sweet, making them a hit with both kids and adults. Perfect for parties, gifts, or a sweet snack anytime.

name: Graeter's Ice Cream
dsc: Graeter's Ice Cream's Choose Your Own 6 Pints allows you to select six of their famous ice cream flavors. Graeter's is known for its French pot process, which creates a rich, creamy texture and allows for generous chunks of chocolate and other mix-ins. Choose from flavors like Black Raspberry Chocolate Chip, Mint Chocolate Chip, and many more. This pack is perfect for families, parties, or anyone who loves premium ice cream.

name: Eli's Cheesecake Company
dsc: Eli's Cheesecake Company's Candy Cookie Cheesecake Sampler features a selection of their most popular cheesecake flavors. From classic plain to chocolate chip, turtle, and Oreo, each slice is creamy, rich, and delicious. Eli's has been making award-winning cheesecakes in Chicago since 1980, and this sampler is a great way to experience their expertise. Perfect for sharing or enjoying over several days.

name: Colts Chocolate
dsc: Colts Chocolate's Chocolate Marshmallows are a delightful treat that combines the fluffy texture of marshmallows with the rich flavor of premium chocolate. Each marshmallow is hand-dipped in smooth, creamy chocolate, creating a perfect balance of sweetness and indulgence. These marshmallows are perfect for snacking, adding to hot cocoa, or roasting over a fire. Made with high-quality ingredients and crafted with care, these chocolate marshmallows are a favorite among both kids and adults. A wonderful gift for any chocolate lover.

name: Magnolia Bakery
dsc: Magnolia Bakery's World Famous Banana Pudding is a New York City icon that has been delighting dessert lovers for decades. This version comes in individual pudding cups, making it perfect for portion control or on-the-go enjoyment. Each cup features layers of smooth vanilla pudding, fresh bananas, and crunchy vanilla wafers, topped with whipped cream. The pudding is made fresh using a secret recipe that has made Magnolia Bakery a household name. Whether enjoyed as a midday treat or a dessert after dinner, this banana pudding never disappoints.

name: Brooklyn Cupcake
dsc: Brooklyn Cupcake's Brooklyn Blackout Cupcake Jars feature layers of rich chocolate cake, chocolate pudding, and chocolate frosting, all packed into convenient jars. This dessert is inspired by the classic Brooklyn Blackout Cake and offers the same intense chocolate flavor in a portable format. Each jar is topped with chocolate cake crumbs for added texture. Perfect for parties, gifts, or a decadent treat on the go.

name: Breads Bakery
dsc: Breads Bakery's Chocolate and Cinnamon Babka 3-pack includes three of their most popular babkas. Each babka is rich, buttery, and filled with either chocolate or cinnamon. The bread is braided and baked to perfection, resulting in a soft, fluffy texture with a slightly crisp crust. This pack is perfect for those who want to enjoy both flavors. A New York City favorite.

name: The Gingered Peach
dsc: The Gingered Peach's Dessert Bars 9-pack allows you to choose nine of their delicious dessert bars. Options include brownies, lemon bars, pecan squares, and more. Each bar is baked fresh with high-quality ingredients and is perfect for any occasion. This pack is great for parties, gifts, or simply stocking up on your favorite treats.

name: Weikel's Bakery
dsc: Weikel's Bakery's Cinnamon Rolls and Honey Bees Sampler Pack features two dozen of their most popular sweet treats. The cinnamon rolls are soft, gooey, and topped with a creamy icing, while the honey bees are bite-sized pastries filled with a sweet honey-nut mixture. This sampler is perfect for sharing with family and friends or enjoying over a lazy weekend morning. A Texas favorite.

name: Junior's Cheesecake
dsc: Junior's Original Cheesecake is a New York City institution that has been delighting dessert lovers since 1950. This classic cheesecake features a creamy, velvety filling on a buttery sponge cake crust. It is made with fresh cream cheese and high-quality ingredients, resulting in a rich and satisfying dessert. This plain cheesecake is perfect for those who appreciate the pure, unadulterated flavor of a traditional New York cheesecake. Serve it as is or top with your favorite fruit or sauce.

name: Ferrara Bakery
dsc: Ferrara Bakery's Little Italy Dessert Pack brings the flavors of New York's historic Little Italy to your home. This pack includes a selection of Italian pastries and desserts, including cannoli, sfogliatelle, and biscotti. Each item is made fresh using authentic recipes that have been passed down through generations. This pack is perfect for those who want to experience the rich culinary heritage of Italian-American desserts.

name: Nightingale Ice Cream Sandwiches
dsc: Nightingale Ice Cream Sandwiches' Cookie Monster 8-Pack features their signature ice cream sandwiches made with soft, chewy chocolate chip cookies and creamy vanilla ice cream. The cookies are packed with chocolate chunks, and the ice cream is rich and smooth. Each sandwich is individually wrapped for freshness and convenience. Perfect for parties, summer days, or just a delicious treat anytime.

name: Honey Cheesecakes
dsc: Honey Cheesecakes' Cinnamon Roll Cheesecake combines the best of two beloved desserts. This cheesecake features a creamy, vanilla cheesecake filling swirled with cinnamon and sugar, on a buttery graham cracker crust. It is topped with a cream cheese icing and a sprinkle of cinnamon, just like a traditional cinnamon roll. Each slice is a perfect balance of creamy, sweet, and spicy flavors. A unique and delicious twist on classic cheesecake.

name: Nye's Cream Sandwiches
dsc: Nye's Cream Sandwiches' Choose Your Own 8-Pack allows you to customize your ice cream sandwich selection. Choose from a variety of cookie flavors and ice cream combinations, all made with premium ingredients. Each sandwich is handcrafted and wrapped for freshness. This pack is perfect for those who want to try different flavors or cater to various tastes at a party.

name: The Puddery
dsc: The Puddery's Banana Pudding Sampler 4-Pack includes four different variations of their famous banana pudding. From classic banana pudding to flavors like chocolate banana and peanut butter banana, each cup is made with fresh bananas and creamy pudding. This sampler is perfect for those who want to try a variety of flavors and find their favorite.

name: Oneg Bakery
dsc: Oneg Bakery's Double Chocolate Babka is a rich and buttery bread filled with layers of dark chocolate. Each slice is a swirl of chocolatey goodness, with a soft, tender crumb and a slightly crisp exterior. This babka is perfect for breakfast, dessert, or a sweet snack any time of day. Made fresh in Brooklyn using traditional Jewish baking techniques, this babka is a true delight for chocolate lovers.

name: Breads Bakery
dsc: Breads Bakery's Chocolate Babka 3-pack features three loaves of their famous chocolate babka. Each babka is rich, buttery, and filled with layers of dark chocolate, baked to a golden brown with a crispy, sugary topping. Breads Bakery has become a New York City icon for their babka, and this 3-pack is perfect for sharing with family and friends, or freezing for later.

name: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate
dsc: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate's Cheesecake Macarons 24-pack combines two beloved desserts into one elegant treat. These macarons feature a delicate, crispy shell filled with a creamy cheesecake-flavored filling. Each macaron is a perfect balance of texture and flavor, with a hint of tanginess from the cheesecake filling. This 24-pack is perfect for parties, gifts, or a sophisticated dessert spread. A truly unique and delicious creation.

name: Junior's Cheesecake
dsc: Junior's Brownie Explosion Cheesecake is a decadent dessert that combines two favorites: rich, fudgy brownies and creamy New York cheesecake. This cheesecake features a brownie base, a creamy cheesecake filling studded with brownie chunks, and a chocolate ganache topping. Each slice is a chocolate lover's dream. A perfect indulgence for any celebration.

name: Carousel Cakes
dsc: Carousel Cakes' Chocolate Mousse Supreme Cake is a light and airy dessert that is perfect for any occasion. This cake features layers of chocolate cake filled with creamy chocolate mousse and covered in a smooth chocolate ganache. Each bite melts in your mouth, offering a delicious balance of flavors and textures. A perfect choice for chocolate lovers.

name: Cookie Good
dsc: Cookie Good's S'mores Cookie 12-Pack features a gourmet twist on the classic campfire treat. These cookies are packed with chocolate chunks, marshmallows, and graham cracker crumbs, creating all the flavors of a s'more in a soft, chewy cookie. Each bite is a perfect combination of chocolatey, gooey, and crunchy. This pack is perfect for sharing with friends and family.

name: Elegant Desserts
dsc: Elegant Desserts' Choose Your Own Ice Cream Donuts 12-Pack is the larger version of their popular ice cream donuts. This pack includes 12 gourmet donuts filled with premium ice cream in your choice of flavors. Each donut is freshly baked, then filled with creamy ice cream and topped with your choice of glazes and sprinkles. Perfect for parties, events, or a sweet treat for the whole family.

name: Brooklyn Cupcake
dsc: Brooklyn Cupcake's Chocolate Covered Cupcake half-dozen features six delicious cupcakes topped with a rich chocolate coating. Each cupcake is moist and flavorful, with a variety of fillings and toppings that make them irresistible. Perfect for parties, gifts, or simply satisfying your sweet tooth. These cupcakes are a Brooklyn favorite.

name: Pietisserie
dsc: Pietisserie's Raspberry Chocolate Pie is a stunning dessert that combines rich chocolate ganache with tart raspberries. The pie features a buttery, flaky crust filled with layers of velvety chocolate and a raspberry compote. Topped with fresh raspberries and chocolate shavings, this pie is both beautiful and delicious. It's perfect for holiday gatherings, birthdays, or any special occasion.

name: Nye's Cream Sandwiches
dsc: Nye's Cream Sandwiches' Best Sellers Ice Cream Sandwich 8-Pack includes their most popular flavor combinations. Choose from classic vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, and more, each sandwiched between two soft, chewy cookies. These ice cream sandwiches are made with premium ingredients and are a crowd favorite. Perfect for summer parties or a cool treat any day.

name: Appalachia Cookie Company
dsc: Appalachia Cookie Company's Chocolate Chip Cookies are made with a classic recipe that has been perfected over time. These cookies are packed with premium chocolate chips and have a perfect balance of crispy edges and a soft, chewy center. Baked fresh in Boone, North Carolina, these cookies are a favorite among locals and visitors alike. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Tipsy Scoop Boozy Ice Cream
dsc: Tipsy Scoop Boozy Ice Cream's 4-Pint Pack allows you to choose four pints of their delicious alcohol-infused ice cream. Flavors include bourbon vanilla, spiked chocolate, and rum raisin. Each pint contains a generous amount of premium spirits, making this a truly unique and adult treat. Perfect for parties or a special night in.

name: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate
dsc: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate's Cheesecake Macarons 12-pack is a smaller version of their popular macaron collection. These elegant macarons feature a crispy shell and a creamy cheesecake-flavored filling. Perfect for a sophisticated dessert or a thoughtful gift. Made with premium ingredients and crafted with care.

name: The Puddery
dsc: The Puddery's Banana Pudding Choose Your Own 4-Pack allows you to select four of their delicious banana pudding flavors. From classic to chocolate banana and peanut butter banana, each cup is made with fresh bananas and creamy pudding. This pack is perfect for those who want to try different varieties or share with friends and family. A delicious and versatile treat.
